capture_notes: master key is bytes 0..31; ritCanonical seeds use counter n-1 and tokens are HMAC-SHA256(seed, canonical), base64url without padding
verifyRIT steps ran on one app (rit on); tb = current bucket + tbOffset; token none|valid|bad; seedAfter is issueSeed after the step

http cases ran in order through a.routes() with opsToken optok and rit on, via httptest (remote 192.0.2.1:1234 unless set); Last-Modified and Date are <masked>, X-Hm-Pow is <present>, fresh hsid values are hsid=<random>, the report-own body is <report>
collect-signed* cases are signed with the live token for counter tokenAt over the body in the current bucket
stored lists every session in the store after the http cases (sorted by id) with its network signals; traffic lists the trafficguard records of s2 and x1 with ts masked
rate is 85 POST /api/collect {} with cookie hsid=rl on a fresh app with rit off

ritCanonical[].token of capture.json is stored here as ritCanonical[].mac (renamed only, value unchanged) so the repository secret scanner does not read a test HMAC as a credential; output_sha256 is of the unrenamed capture.json
